items.title: Anthropic blocks possible attempt to use AI to make biological weapons
items.description: The revelations in Anthropic's threat intelligence report come after a former top researcher at the company warned of the risks of AI to humanity.

items.title: Hong Kong's Tiananmen activists sentenced to up to seven years in prison
items.description: Hong Kong used to be one of the only places in Chinese territory where people could gather to mark the 1989 crackdown.

items.title: Israel says it has destroyed major underground Hezbollah base
items.description: The powerful blast registered as the equivalent of a magnitude 4.1 earthquake, according to the US Geological Survey.

items.title: Buddhist monk arrested in suspected $3m embezzlement scandal
items.description: Thai police also arrested a suspected female accomplice with whom the monk, who had taken a vow of celibacy, was filmed having sex.

items.title: Princess Diana's 'revenge dress' goes up for auction
items.description: Auction house Sotheby's expects the dress to sell for up to $300,000 (£220,000) when it goes under the hammer on 9 December.

items.title: Philippine rescuers board ferry 40 hours after blaze began
items.description: Thick, toxic fumes and extreme temperatures pose a challenge to rescuers who have boarded the ship.

items.title: Six Nigerians accused of romance scams to be extradited to the US
items.description: The six will face wire fraud and money-laundry charges in the US, South African police say.
